newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hoyts to develop 300 S.American screens.
newsitem.headline: Hoyts to develop 300 S.American screens.

text.p: Hoyts Cinemas Ltd said on Wednesday it had reached a joint venture agreement with a South American real estate group to develop about 300 movie screens in Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay.
The company also said it had secured four sites with 42 screens in northern Argentina.

Hoyts said the venture is with South American property group Raghsa Construcciones S.A. The Sydney-based cinema group has recently expanded into Chile and Mexico. The company also has screens in Australia, New Zealand and the United States.

Hoyts chief executive officer Peter Ivany said in a statement: "It is widely acknowledged that the Latin American markets are currently underscreened, providing substantial opportunity for multiplex development."
"Argentina also represents one of these underdeveloped markets, with the potential for significant growth," Ivany said.
